propositions: write-side transient runner-FS faults (unable to create temporary file, failed to insert into database, unable to index file) abort store git operations through run_git_write because the shared seam's retry family covers only READ-side signatures

event_append's git add path already recognizes and retries the identical write-side fault via _TRANSIENT_ADD_MARKERS, creating asymmetry where the store self-heals on one path and red-lights CI on others

the write-side marker family must be moved into gitutil as a single shared definition with corresponding transient-fault predicate so every run_git_write caller (s3_doctor, compaction, claim/transition writers) inherits bounded retry
corrupt-object signatures (loose object is corrupt, inflate data stream error) must remain excluded from retry to avoid masking genuine data faults
the nested 3x3 retry composition on commit paths must be collapsed to bounded single-loop retry matching the read-side budget
